description: This file defines course data structures, constants, and sample course data for an educational platform. It includes course roles, phases, statuses, content types, modules, and sample courses for instructor creation and learner consumption.

methods.name: toLearnerModules
methods.description: Converts canonical course modules into learner-facing module format, including videos, readings, quizzes, and assignments.

methods.name: getCoursesForInstructor
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all canonical courses for instructor view, sorted by last updated date.

methods.name: getInitialCanonicalCourses
methods.description: Provides a deep copy of the initial canonical courses array for state hydration.

methods.name: getPublishedCoursesForPath
methods.description: Filters and returns published courses matching a specific path slug, with special handling for 'fullstack' path.

methods.name: getCourseById
methods.description: Finds and returns a course by its ID.

methods.name: getAvailableAssessments
methods.description: Returns a list of available assessment objects (quizzes and assignments).
